subject: Pen test artifacts, ticket traces and compensating controls request
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme-cloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for penetration test artifacts, ticket traces, and controls description

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this on. Our security team reviewed the high-level remediation summary you provided during the demo last week and they have a few follow-ups before we can close our assessment:

1) Can you share the raw penetration test report (PDF) and the set of remediation artifacts you relied on to verify fixes (screenshots, config exports, patch timestamps)?
2) For each fixed finding (we track SEC-4574, SEC-4591, SEC-4603), please include the related ticket IDs, a short timeline of actions, and the verification evidence (e.g., a screenshot of the rule change + timestamped system log entry).
3) We need a short write-up of any compensating controls you applied (logging, IDS tuning, MFA enforcement) and how those controls reduce residual risk — ideally mapped to the SIG/SOC 2 control where relevant.
4) If any artifacts are not shareable, please provide an explanation and an alternative attestation or summary.

We have a procurement checkpoint next Friday and need materials by EOD Thursday if possible. If you need more time, let us know a firm delivery date.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Cole
Security Engineer, Acme Cloud
---
Note: this request is limited to remediation artifacts related to the recent internal pen test scope (app + infra).

Hi Jared —

Appreciate the clear list. We're pulling all the items you asked for. High level plan:
- Rishi (security) will export the pen test PDF and collect per-finding evidence (screenshots, configs, logs).
- We'll export the Jira traces and redact any internal-only debug output before sharing.
- Monica (CS) will prepare the SIG/SOC 2 control mapping and a short compensating-controls summary for your reviewers.

Deliverables we expect to share by Thu EOD (or sooner):
- Full pen test report (pt-scan-report-2027-01.pdf)
- Per-finding artifact bundle (screenshots + config exports)
- Jira trace CSV for SEC-4574/4591/4603 (jira-SEC-4574-export.csv)
- Compensating controls memo (brief PDF)

If we hit anything sensitive that can't be shared, we'll provide a redacted attestation and a proposed alternative. Rishi — can you confirm the expected list of files and whether we need an extension? Monica — can you start the controls mapping?

Thanks —
Steph

Thanks — that looks good. A couple quick follow-ups before we close the item:

1) For compensating controls: can you provide a concise statement for each control (logging retention, IDS rules, MFA enforcement) that outlines: what the control is, where it is configured, how it's monitored, and who owns it? A one-paragraph description per control is ideal.
2) For the logging screenshot, please include the log retention setting and the earliest available timestamp in the sample you provide.
3) If you can attach the S3 object metadata with checksums for the report PDF, that would help our chain-of-custody requirements.

If you can get these by tomorrow EOD PST we'll mark the findings as resolved on our side and move the procurement review forward.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Jared
